mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 77 degrees at the Verona Public Library. Tonight, we have a first quarter moon, and you can spot the International Space Station at 9:33 PM as it travels from the northwest near Verona High School toward the east over Fitchburg, reaching halfway up the sky.

In city news, the VHAT cable channel provides access to our government meetings and community programming on Spectrum and TDS. Also, a reminder that the city has specific ordinances regarding vehicle storage, requiring all recreational equipment to be kept on approved surfaces and properly screened from neighbors.

It is a big week for events in Verona. Starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Louie this Tuesday, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga sessions, and Wednesday night trivia at The Bogey Factory. Plus, do not forget our Concerts in the Park series this Thursday.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident on July 14 where a traffic stop led to the seizure of marijuana and a firearm, resulting in citations for the occupants.

You can still grab today's flavor, the Chocolate Caramel Twist, at our local Culver's until they close at 10 PM. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Mint Explosion, and the shop opens again tomorrow morning.
